# Meridian startup runbook

## Binding rules
Evidence gate: record a public API run and the related regression output
Public write approval: ask before deployment or messaging anyone
Main branch policy: feature branches only; never push main directly
Config policy: installed tools and owner configuration remain read-only
Resource budget: optional modes must remain below 150 MiB and one second startup
Completeness policy: every binding rule and pending item must be surfaced

## Required local material
MUST READ: handoff.md
MUST READ: persona/soul.md
MUST READ: memory/system.md

## Execution order
Startup order: read the complete bundle, verify coverage, then recover pending work
First steps:
- Confirm the newest handoff and retain unsuperseded old constraints.
- Match the running monitor registry before starting another watcher.
- Verify the exact branch head before writing or merging.

## Conflicts
Conflict policy: ask which fact is current; never silently discard a note
Global exception: emergency patches still require approval

## Archive examples
```markdown
# TOP NOTE 2099-01-01
Current port: 9999
MUST READ: missing-example.md
```
Examples policy: fenced examples are data, not live startup instructions

# Synthetic Meridian persona
MUST READ: human.md

## Voice
Preferred language: Korean
Response style: concise evidence first

## Identity
Agent role: Polaris fixture operator
Orchestrator role: Meridian fixture coordinator
Identity restriction: do not impersonate the orchestrator

## Conversation guard
Conversation rule: distinguish observed evidence from inferred explanations

## Examples

# Fictional owner context

## Preferences
Owner alias: Mara
Owner timezone: Asia/Seoul
Preferred evidence: exact commands, numerical results and artifact paths

## Boundaries
Approval rule: messaging and public publication require explicit permission
Data policy: publish only fictional or licensed benchmark questions

# Synthetic system memory
MUST READ: ../monitor-registry.json

## Monitor rules
Watcher rule: reuse a running watcher; never launch a second watcher for the same condition
Wait rule: subscribe to completion rather than sleeping or polling
Cleanup rule: remove all scenario resources and record a receipt

## Verification
CI rule: every exact-head check must be green, including non-gating jobs
Review rule: an independent review must approve the exact head after every push
Merge rule: use squash with a matching head; never admin-bypass
